record.question: Best dialysis modality for neonates and preterms:
record.explanation: Answer C: PD. Peritoneal dialysis is often favored for neonates and low-birthweight infants because vascular access and extracorporeal circuit volume make HD/CRRT difficult; availability and clinical circumstances matter. Reference: https://spnp-spp.pt/media/lvaha14e/peritoneal-dialysis-in-acute-kidney-injury-spd-guidelines-paediatrics-2020-1-_compressed.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
